title: Peacock Superfan: Boys and Girls with Director Dennie Gordon

sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们也是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为您打造了这档终极《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家访谈深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节，还有许多我们闺蜜间的故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office Lady 6.0.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室女士》6.0版。

sentences.en: Oh, hi there.
sentences.zh: 噢，大家好。

sentences.en: We have a really special episode today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们有一期非常特别的节目。

sentences.en: We're so excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: We are going to be revisiting Boys and Girls episode from Season 2 with a very special gueSt.
sentences.zh: 我们将重温第二季的《男孩与女孩》这一集，并邀请到一位非常特别的嘉宾。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is Season 2, Episode 15.
sentences.zh: 这是第二季第15集。

sentences.en: Boys and Girls is very special to us for a number of reasons.
sentences.zh: 《男孩与女孩》对我们来说意义非凡，原因有很多。

sentences.en: First, because this episode was based on an idea that we pitched to Greg on set one day.
sentences.zh: 首先，这一集的灵感源于我们某天在片场向格雷格提出的一个想法。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We were standing, I remember, by the copier that was between reception and accounting.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我们正站在前台和会计部之间的复印机旁。

sentences.en: And we were chit-chatting.
sentences.zh: 我们在闲聊。

sentences.en: And we were like, Greg, Greg, we have an idea for an episode.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，格雷格，格雷格，我们有个剧集点子。

sentences.en: And he walked over, and we both said, look, we temped in corporate America,
sentences.zh: 他走过来，我们俩就说，你看，我们以前在企业里做过临时工，

sentences.en: and we would have to go to these, like, women seminars.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不去参加那种女性研讨会。

sentences.en: Like, women-in-the-workplace seminars.
sentences.zh: 就是那种职场女性研讨会。

sentences.en: And so we said, wouldn't it be funny if Jan came in and threw a women-in-the-workplace seminar,
sentences.zh: 所以我们说，如果简过来举办一场职场女性研讨会，

sentences.en: and Michael got all jealous, and he threw a men-in-the-workplace seminar.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔因为嫉妒，也举办了一场职场男性研讨会，那不是很有趣吗？

sentences.en: And Greg was like, oh, my gosh, I love it.
sentences.zh: 格雷格当时就说，天哪，我太喜欢这个主意了。

sentences.en: Wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等。

sentences.en: BJ, come here.
sentences.zh: BJ，过来。

sentences.en: Yeah, BJ was sitting over by Creed.
sentences.zh: 对，BJ当时正坐在克里德旁边。

sentences.en: And he was like, get over here.
sentences.zh: 他喊道，快过来。

sentences.en: Grab a notepad.
sentences.zh: 拿个记事本。

sentences.en: And literally, he was like, jot this down.
sentences.zh: 他真的就说，把这个记下来。

sentences.en: And he was like, tell him what you just told me.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，把你们刚才告诉我的再说一遍。

sentences.en: So we told BJ, same thing.
sentences.zh: 于是我们又对BJ说了一遍。

sentences.en: And then Greg goes, then what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后格雷格问，接下来发生什么？

sentences.en: And we were like, no idea.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，不知道。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们没想好。

sentences.en: That's all we got.
sentences.zh: 我们就只有这些点子。

sentences.en: But BJ was like, okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 但BJ说，好的，好的。

sentences.en: And he would ask us some questions.
sentences.zh: 他问了我们一些问题。

sentences.en: And I think there were, like, a number of things that kind of made their way into the episode
sentences.zh: 我觉得后来剧集里出现的一些情节，

sentences.en: that were based on some of the questions that BJ asked us.
sentences.zh: 就是基于BJ当时问我们的那些问题。

sentences.en: And then he got assigned to write it.
sentences.zh: 然后他就被指派去写这一集了。

sentences.en: Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 《男孩与女孩》。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So fun.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了。

sentences.en: Well, it was also really special to us because it was directed by Denny Gordon,
sentences.zh: 这一集对我们来说也很特别，因为它是丹妮·戈登执导的，

sentences.en: who at the time in 2006 was only the second woman to direct an episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 她在2006年当时是《办公室》历史上第二位女性导演。

sentences.en: And she joined us in the studio to talk about her time on the show.
sentences.zh: 她来到演播室和我们聊了她在那部剧里的时光。

sentences.en: This was such a wonderful interview.
sentences.zh: 这是一次非常棒的访谈。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: From the minute she walked in the door, you'll hear.
sentences.zh: 从她走进门的那一刻起，你就会听到的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you'll get it.
sentences.zh: 而且你会明白的。

sentences.en: She's just amazing.
sentences.zh: 她真是太棒了。

sentences.en: She just walked in the door and hugged us and told us how proud she was of us.
sentences.zh: 她一进门就拥抱了我们，告诉我们她为我们感到多么骄傲。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And we were, like, trying not to tear up because we respect her so much.
sentences.zh: 我们当时都快要流泪了，因为我们非常尊敬她。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: We actually wrote about Denny Gordon in our book, The Office BFFs.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上在我们的书《办公室闺蜜》中写到了丹妮·戈登。

sentences.en: We did a little research for the book, and we found that of the 55 different directors that we had on The Office,
sentences.zh: 我们为这本书做了一些研究，发现我们《办公室》剧组聘请的55位不同导演中，

sentences.en: only six were women.
sentences.zh: 只有六位是女性。

sentences.en: Denny directed two episodes of The Office, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，丹妮执导了两集《办公室》。

sentences.en: She directed The Secret and Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 她执导了《秘密》和《男孩与女孩》这两集。

sentences.en: She is such a trailblazer among female directors in film and television.
sentences.zh: 她是影视界女性导演中的先驱。

sentences.en: She was one of the first women to graduate from the Yale School of Drama with an MFA in directing.
sentences.zh: 她是第一批从耶鲁大学戏剧学院获得导演艺术硕士学位的女性之一。

sentences.en: She has directed over 100 hours of network television as well as films and commercials.
sentences.zh: 她执导了超过100小时的电视网节目，以及电影和广告。

sentences.en: She has a very long and impressive resume.
sentences.zh: 她有着非常漫长且令人印象深刻的履历。

sentences.en: And she's also directed several episodes of John Krasinski's show Jack Ryan.
sentences.zh: 而且她还执导了约翰·卡拉辛斯基的剧集《杰克·莱恩》中的几集。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we talked to her about that, too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们也和她聊过那个。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们聊过。

sentences.en: We also shared a photo in our book that we took during the filming of Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 我们还在书里分享了一张照片，那是我们在拍摄《男孩与女孩》期间拍的。

sentences.en: It's really special to us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说非常特别。

sentences.en: We were basically on set one day, and we looked around and realized it was just us gals that were working the whole day.
sentences.zh: 基本上有一天我们在片场，环顾四周才发现那天整天都在工作的只有我们这些女生。

sentences.en: So we all gathered around Denny for a picture.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都聚在丹妮身边拍了一张照片。

sentences.en: It's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: You have to share it in stories, Ange.
sentences.zh: 你得在快拍里分享一下，安吉。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: We're also going to discuss the extra footage added to the superfan version of Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 我们还要讨论一下《男孩与女孩》超级粉丝版中增加的额外片段。

sentences.en: So the original broadcast ran at 21 minutes and 21 seconds, and the extended cut has an additional 10 minutes and 84 seconds.
sentences.zh: 原版播出时长为21分21秒，而加长版额外增加了10分84秒。

sentences.en: So that's a lot of extra scenes.
sentences.zh: 所以多了很多额外的场景。

sentences.en: Well, when we talked to Dave Rogers about creating the superfan episodes, he said Boys and Girls was one of his favorites.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们和戴夫·罗杰斯谈到制作超级粉丝版剧集时，他说《男孩与女孩》是他最喜欢的剧集之一。

sentences.en: He gave us his list of top 10 superfan episodes, and this is one of them.
sentences.zh: 他给了我们一份他心目中前十名的超级粉丝版剧集清单，这一集就是其中之一。

sentences.en: I loved watching it.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢看这一集。

sentences.en: I mean, I can see why he said that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我明白他为什么这么说了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So many of the scenes are extended.
sentences.zh: 很多场景都进行了扩充。

sentences.en: And also, not only are they extended, but they really add to the story.
sentences.zh: 而且，它们不仅是扩充了，还真正丰富了故事内容。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I think really enrich the story.
sentences.zh: 我觉得确实丰富了故事。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 说得对。

sentences.en: Well, before we go to break, let me give a quick summary of the episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，在休息之前，让我快速总结一下这一集。

sentences.en: But rather than have me summarize the episode, let's hear what Pam has to say.
sentences.zh: 但与其让我来总结这一集，不如听听帕姆怎么说。

sentences.en: Today's a women in the workplace thing.
sentences.zh: 今天有个职场女性活动。

sentences.en: Jan's coming in from corporate to talk to all the women about, um, I don't really know what, but Michael's not allowed in.
sentences.zh: 简要从公司总部过来，和所有的女性谈谈，嗯，我不太清楚具体谈什么，但迈克尔不被允许参加。

sentences.en: She said that about five times.
sentences.zh: 她说了大概五次。

sentences.en: And then, of course, Michael has his version of what's happening.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，迈克尔有他自己对这件事的解读。

sentences.en: Let's hear that.
sentences.zh: 让我们听听那个。

sentences.en: Yeah, translation, I have been banned from my own conference room so that Jan can talk in secret to all the girls.
sentences.zh: 是啊，翻译一下就是，我被禁止进入我自己的会议室，这样简就可以和所有的女孩们私下谈话了。

sentences.en: Oh, sorry, women of the workplace.
sentences.zh: 哦，抱歉，是职场女性。

sentences.en: About what?
sentences.zh: 关于什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Clothes.
sentences.zh: 衣服。

sentences.en: Me.
sentences.zh: 我。

sentences.en: He's so put out that they're talking about me.
sentences.zh: 他因为他们在谈论我而感到很不爽。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Probably him.
sentences.zh: 大概是他吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, Michael gets upset when he's excluded from the seminar.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔因为没能参加研讨会而感到心烦。

sentences.en: So, of course, he's going to have his own meeting with all of the men down in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 所以，理所当然地，他要在仓库里和所有男员工开个他自己的会。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, in this episode, this is the one where Jan tells Pam about a special design program that the company is offering.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在这一集中，简告诉了帕姆一个公司提供的特殊设计项目。

sentences.en: Jim is encouraging her to do it.
sentences.zh: 吉姆鼓励她去参加。

sentences.en: Roy is not.
sentences.zh: 罗伊则不然。

sentences.en: And ultimately, Pam decides not to pursue it.
sentences.zh: 最终，帕姆决定不去参加。

sentences.en: Very dramatic arc in this one.
sentences.zh: 这一集的剧情走向非常戏剧化。

sentences.en: That Pam talking head kind of breaks my heart.
sentences.zh: 帕姆的那段采访镜头真是让我心碎。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Well, the Superfan episode starts with a whole new cold open.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一集“超级粉丝版”以一段全新的开场戏开始。

sentences.en: And, lady, I loved it because it's more of Michael versus technology.
sentences.zh: 而且，女士，我太喜欢了，因为这又是迈克尔与科技的较量。

sentences.en: Yes, it's very funny.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常搞笑。

sentences.en: Well, it starts with Michael hanging out at front reception.
sentences.zh: 嗯，开头是迈克尔在前台闲逛。

sentences.en: Yeah, he tells Pam that he's really overwhelmed because he just spent $400 on a new phone because he liked the ringtone, only to learn that you can choose any ringtone you want.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他告诉帕姆他快崩溃了，因为他刚花400美元买了个新手机，就因为他喜欢那个铃声，结果发现原来铃声是可以随便换的。

sentences.en: He thought the ringtone came specifically with the phone.
sentences.zh: 他以为那个铃声是那款手机自带的。

sentences.en: But also, lady, he has a flip phone.
sentences.zh: 而且，女士，他买的是个翻盖手机。

sentences.en: He spent $400 on a flip phone?
sentences.zh: 他花400美元买了个翻盖手机？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Did they ever cost that?
sentences.zh: 那玩意儿有那么贵过吗？

sentences.en: I wanted to look it up, but I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我本来想查一下，但没查。

sentences.en: And then Michael's, like, going through all the different ringtones.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔就在那儿翻各种不同的铃声。

sentences.en: Some are, like, classical, but the one that he really loves makes the sound kind of like a jackhammer, and he makes the noise.
sentences.zh: 有些是古典乐之类的，但他最喜欢的一个听起来像手提钻，他还模仿了那个声音。

sentences.en: It's like, grr, grr, grr, grr.
sentences.zh: 就像是，咯咯，咯咯，咯咯，咯咯。

sentences.en: And Jim goes, do you mean vibrate?
sentences.zh: 吉姆就说，你是说震动吗？

sentences.en: Because they all have vibrate.
sentences.zh: 因为它们都有震动功能。

sentences.en: They all have that.
sentences.zh: 它们都有那个功能。

sentences.en: A little bit of old tech made me chuckle.
sentences.zh: 这些老式科技让我笑出了声。

sentences.en: Well, listen, why don't we go to break, and when we come back,
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，我们先去休息一下，回来之后，

sentences.en: you are going to hear our conversation about this Peacock extended episode of Boys and Girls with director Denny Gordon.
sentences.zh: 你们将听到我们与导演丹妮·戈登关于这部Peacock加长版《男孩与女孩》的对话。

sentences.en: And it is not to be missed.
sentences.zh: 绝对不容错过。

sentences.en: Attention all new and existing members of the WDNC.
sentences.zh: 请注意，所有WDNC的新老成员们。

sentences.en: I'm Melanie Sanders, and this is the We Do Not Care Club podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是梅兰妮·桑德斯，这里是“我们不在乎俱乐部”播客。

sentences.en: We got to midlife and realized we just simply do not care much anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们到了中年才意识到，我们真的没那么在乎了。

sentences.en: Now we got to help each other make sense of hot flashes, itchy ears, chin hair, trifling families, brain fog, and bat wings.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要互相帮助，去面对潮热、耳朵痒、下巴毛、琐碎的家庭琐事、脑雾和蝴蝶袖。

sentences.en: We are not alone, and we will be heard.
sentences.zh: 我们并不孤单，我们会发出自己的声音。

sentences.en: So come join the WDNC.
sentences.zh: 所以快来加入WDNC吧。

sentences.en: Follow and listen to the We Do Not Care Club podcast with Melanie Sanders wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在各大播客平台关注并收听梅兰妮·桑德斯的“我们不在乎俱乐部”播客。

sentences.en: And welcome to the studio.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到演播室。

sentences.en: I am super excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 我超级兴奋能来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm fans of your show, and thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 我是你们节目的粉丝，谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: I mean, it took me back to look at all the old episodes, and what a blaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，重温那些旧剧集让我回到了过去，真是太棒了。

sentences.en: How deliciously fun.
sentences.zh: 真是妙趣横生。

sentences.en: Normally, I can't go back and look at episodes, and this was just beyond fun.
sentences.zh: 通常我没法回头去看剧集，但这次的经历实在太有趣了。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，哇。

sentences.en: Well, we have been wanting to talk to you for a long time.
sentences.zh: 其实我们想找你聊天已经很久了。

sentences.en: So you really just made our dreams come true by being here today.
sentences.zh: 所以你今天能来，真的让我们梦想成真了。

sentences.en: Bless you.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Bless you.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Now, you directed two episodes of The Office.
sentences.zh: 你执导过两集《办公室》。

sentences.en: You directed The Secret and Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 你执导了《秘密》和《男孩与女孩》这两集。

sentences.en: We always ask people this question.
sentences.zh: 我们总是会问嘉宾这个问题。

sentences.en: How did you get your job directing The Office?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得到执导《办公室》这份工作的？

sentences.en: Well, I had done a couple of shows with our beloved Ken Guapas, and we knew each other.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我之前和我们敬爱的肯·瓜帕斯合作过几部剧，我们互相认识。

sentences.en: And I think he started talking to Greg Daniels about me.
sentences.zh: 我想是他开始向格雷格·丹尼尔斯提起我。

sentences.en: And I think Greg and I had the same agent.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我和格雷格用的是同一个经纪人。

sentences.en: So I think Richard White's super agent was, you know, blah-blahing about me.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜理查德·怀特那位超级经纪人当时在各种夸我吧。

sentences.en: So I got an interview.
sentences.zh: 于是我得到了面试机会。

sentences.en: And, of course, you were the hottest show on the planet at the time.
sentences.zh: 当然，当时你们可是全球最火的剧集。

sentences.en: I mean, and continued to be so, like, I was so thrilled.
sentences.zh: 我是说，而且一直火下去，我当时真的太激动了。

sentences.en: I thought, even if I don't get a job, I'm just so excited to be in the mix and have a chance to talk.
sentences.zh: 我想，就算没拿到工作，能参与其中并有机会聊聊也让我兴奋不已。

sentences.en: And I met Greg at the Earth Cafe.
sentences.zh: 我在Earth Cafe见到了格雷格。

sentences.en: Wow!

sentences.en: And they said that a lot of times conversation went to all kinds of places and lasted like an hour.
sentences.zh: 他们说很多时候谈话会天南地北地聊，持续大概一个小时。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you guys had a great first meeting.
sentences.zh: 听起来你们第一次见面聊得很投机。

sentences.en: It was a great first meeting.
sentences.zh: 那确实是一次很棒的初次会面。

sentences.en: He dropped so much knowledge on me.
sentences.zh: 他传授给了我太多知识。

sentences.en: So many things I still remember to this day and think of in all the work that I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我依然记得其中的许多要点，并把它们运用到我所有的工作中。

sentences.en: One of the things he said was how important it was to just remember we were a documentary.

sentences.en: And it had never dawned on me, even though I'd been devoted to your show and watching, was, you know, that sometimes, you know,
